rationale: S-0026-06 proposes NMDA-block and TTX-sensitivity sweeps at each V_rest on t0022 and t0024. Both substrate lineages have been de-emphasised since brainstorm 9. The NMDA-block question is being addressed differently in the from-scratch wave (t0054 with voltage-independent NMDA, t0055 with Mg-block NMDA); the TTX (Na channel inactivation) question is connected to the un-yet-touched research question Q1 (g_Na/g_K combinations). Reprioritising from high to medium pending the from-scratch wave reaching the active-conductance variation track.
